prd-review-session.md records the mandatory Engineering, QA, and Marketing PRD review session before major coding starts. The current v0.0.1 lane is backfilled as GO-WITH-NOTES because implementation was already in flight; future major Vaporize coding slices must pass this gate before coding.

vaporware-modification-request-discipline.md distinguishes vaporware feature requests as product input from vaporware modification requests as controlled engineering execution, leaving room for future hardware or other material-domain request families. It defines behavior-changing vaporware modification requests as release work: they create or attach to an owning bead in the owning component or workstream home; create or attach to a feature flag, feature status record, or release-feature cohort; add or update targetable tests; run the smallest feature-scoped proof; update release evidence and schema fixtures when affected; and record explicit no-flag or no-bead exceptions.

A pass proves spine coherence, not final release approval.

list-targets emits a vaporize-project-target-discovery receipt for Creative Selection v0.2 project.pkl with target, package, scheme, and buildable-candidate facts; this proves AppleProjectSpec target discovery, not build/install/generation, cache warming, or .xcworkspace graph membership discovery

list-targets maps Creative Selection v0.2 buildable target facts to one shared DerivedData product-cache candidate and reports missing status; this proves candidate-path and warm/missing discovery, not .xcworkspace graph parsing, cache warming, fleet cache coverage, or disk-savings measurement

list-schemes routes xcodebuild -list -json -workspace through Vaporize/CommonProcess and CUJ-20 covers CLI parsing, argument construction, Xcode JSON parsing, input validation, and receipt boundaries; large-workspace runtime, product paths, cache warming, and fleet coverage remain unproven

cuj-state-coverage.json names every required CUJ-state id for the SCM product-suite fixture and attaches CUJ-21 proof entries; release-doctor checks coverage status, required ids, proof floor, uncovered ids, unknown ids, and duplicate proof ids. This proves journey-derived state coverage, not Kura adapter readiness or public release approval.

Every brochure must have an audience packet and user manual. Carrie CMO (cmo-chief-marketing-officer-carrie@wrkstrm.occupations.org) owns the consumer-facing publication gate for public-disclosure surfaces; wrkstrm-core owns Vaporize implementation evidence and release-doctor mechanics. public-brochure.html, evidence/audience-packet.su.json, user-manual.md, public-brochure.md, and public-changelog.md define the external public disclosure draft surface, remain constrained by performance-marketing-claims.md, and preserve the blocked release/publication boundary. This proves packet shape, not public launch approval or Sparkle appcast/signing readiness.

CUJ-22 proves the release-facing simulation proving ground: scenario coverage fails when a required receipt is missing, and Vaporize carries processed text, copied directory, decoded JSON, byte-count, and stale-reinstall resource scenarios from SwiftPM --show-bin-path products into ~/.swiftpm/bin away from .build. CUJ-01 retains the lower-level regression proof for the raw experimental-install gap. Product metadata lives in the Vaporize CLI metadata sidecar. This proves resource-bearing CLI installs, not app bundle packaging, Bundle.main product metadata, Sparkle appcast generation, update signing, or public update delivery.

CUJ-23 proves proving-ground passports: a Vaporize CLI product profile and the Pkl project-generation proving-ground profile name product class, owning bead, CUJs, required tracks, scenarios, targetable tests, receipt refs, and release-doctor checks. The adoption gate fails incomplete passports with missing tracks, missing receipts, missing targetable tests, missing CUJ refs, or unknown tracks. This proves adoption evidence shape, not product-specific release approval.
